author: Fouled
body:
Lots of people have been asking if their map has been tested yet, so we decided to create a Map Testing Spreadsheet, which will contain information on your maps status. It will obviously be viewed to the community, so we hope this helps! :)
NOTE: We will be updating the sheet frequently.

Click here for the spreadsheet
